answer.book: Latin edition of Philippus Lansbergius's Commentationes in motum terrae diurnum et annuum (Middelburg, 1630), a single work built as front matter (Hortensius's preface, Lansbergius's address to the reader and dedication), then two controversies on the diurnal and annual motion, then a second part on the true typus of the visible heaven, divided into sections on the three heavens, ending with Finis.
